paper_title: Upper Limit on the QCD Axion Mass from Isolated Neutron Star Cooling
notes: Isolated neutron-star cooling bound. Headline result is a QCD axion mass limit m_a < 16 meV (KSVZ, 95%). The model-independent coupling bound is stated in the text (Letter, near ref to IAXO): 'In the axion model with only an axion-neutron (axion-proton) coupling we constrain |g_ann| < 1.3e-9 (|g_app| < 1.5e-9) at 95% confidence.' Reported here as the main (axion-neutron) result; the axion-proton bound is |g_app| < 1.5e-9. Paper defines g_aNN = C_N m_N/f_a from L = (C_N/2f_a) dmu(a) Nbar gamma^mu gamma5 N, i.e. the canonical 2m_N normalization (g_aN/2m_N) dmu(a) Nbar gamma^mu gamma5 N, so no conversion is needed. Reported as a flat horizontal exclusion at g_an=1.3e-9 (region above excluded); the mass-range endpoints (1e-9 to 0.1 eV) are indicative of the light-axion regime where thermal NS emission applies and are not tied to a specific stated range. Value from text; the 2D g_ann-g_app exclusion is in SM Fig. ganngapp.pdf. No dark-matter density dependence (cooling, not a DM search). Confidence 95%.
